HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/beach sandals
- Hiking shoes/boots (for Diamond Head hike)
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - can rent but better to bring your own)
- Water shoes (for rocky beaches)
- Beach bag
- Quick-dry clothing

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking gear (appropriate footwear, moisture-wicking clothes)
- Day backpack
- Water bottle/hydration pack
- Trail snacks
- Insect repellent
- Small first aid kit

EVENING ACTIVITIES:
- Luau-appropriate attire (aloha shirt, sundress, etc.)
- Slightly nicer outfit for dinner at restaurants
- Light sweater for air-conditioned venues

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Hair ties/headbands
- Book/e-reader for beach relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Small umbrella or rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Shopping bag for souvenirs

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach games, cooler for drinks
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera, waterproof bag
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Energy bars, trail map
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire, comfortable shoes
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist downloaded
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian accessories, lei (can buy there too)
- June 17 (Spa day): Swimsuit for spa facilities
- June 18 (Kailua kayaking): Quick-dry clothes, waterproof watch
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags, list of gift recipients
